text:
Ava: Quick check — finalizing welcome/drip for Nimble launch. Thinking: 4-message nurture + targeted weekly digest. Goals: activation, benchmark webinar signups, product evals.
Diego: +1. Proposed segments: interest_tag: [benchmarks, infra, integrations]; size: micro (1-15), smb (16-250), enterprise (250+); VIP: invited accounts + engaged in last 30d.
Priya: Copy Qs — do we localize for APAC? Or just timezone sends? I'd like simple zh/en for APAC if we have translations.
Connor: Ops: We'll do timezone sends (APAC/EU/NA) and ramped throttle. Use subaccount "nimble-launch" in Braze, include suppression for "do-not-email" and bounced_90d. Also add header for List-Unsubscribe.
Zoe: Design: hero with 3-up benchmark stat cards + CTA. Need copy: 35-char headline + 80-char subhead. Will supply two variants.
Ava: Nurture skeleton: Day 0 welcome (setup + quick links), Day 3 product deep-dive, Day 7 customer story (SMB or Ent depending on segment), Day 12 webinar invite (with stat teaser), Day 18 final reminder.
Diego: A/B tests: webinar subject (stat teaser vs benefits-first), hero CTA (Webinar vs Download benchmark PDF), subject lines suggestions and openers.
Priya: I'll handle translations for APAC (simplified Chinese + JP short strings). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Connor: Preflight checklist for Ops: seed list send to 10 internal PII addresses, deliverability check with Mailgun, SPF/DKIM review, warmup status, Braze throttle config: 4500/hr then 15k/hr after 48h.
DeployBot: Campaign draft created: MKT-NIMBLE-2026-04 (id: 9224). Schedule blocked until assets uploaded.
Ava: Action items: Diego builds segments + test plan; Zoe provides hero + templates; Priya translations; Connor schedule + deliverability; Diego to export CSV and share by EOD. We'll do quick sign-off 10am tomorrow.
Diego: on it. ping me if we need to cut a segment.
Zoe: mockups in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/nimble-launch (tagged @Ava @Priya)
Priya: noted, will sync translations there.
Ava: Thanks team! Let's avoid heavy copy in subject — short and clear. :rocket:
